channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English
channel.description: English fact summaries of Japanese corporate filings from EDINET.

item.title: Shobunsha Holdings Co., Ltd.: MSE, Inc. launches MBO tender offer for Shobunsha Holdings at JPY 752 per share.
item.description: Tender offer period runs from 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days). | Tender price is JPY 752 per common share. | Minimum purchase number is 6,633,100 shares (37.03%); no maximum is set. | Filer holds 3,428,500 target shares (19.14%); Kuroda Shigeo holds 1,879,700 shares (10.49%) and has agreed not to tender. | Target's board resolved to express support for the tender offer and recommend that shareholders tender. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: UP GARAGE GROUP Co., Ltd.: UP GARAGE GROUP launches self-tender offer for treasury shares at 10% discount to market price.
item.description: Class of shares: common stock; planned purchase quantity 880,000 shares (ownership ratio 11.09%). | Offer price 1,197 yen, a 10% discount to the 1,330 yen six-month average closing price as of 2026-11-05. | Parent company E&E holds 5,664,300 shares (71.40%) and intends to sell 800,000 shares (10.08%) for cash. | Announcement date 2026-11-06; filing submitted 2026-11-09 to the Kanto Local Finance Bureau. | Purchase funds to be entirely covered by own funds; the filing states 14 billion yen of liquidity expected at settlement start. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Hobu Co., Ltd.: Takahashi Kikaku launches tender offer for Hobu shares at JPY 1,140 per share.
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days) | Offer price: JPY 1,140 per common share | Minimum planned purchase: 202,500 shares; no maximum set | Planned purchase equals 59.93% of the target's total voting rights (filing ratio 0.5993) | Ownership ratio after purchase at minimum: 66.67% (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: SHIP HEALTHCARE HOLDINGS,INC.: Ship Healthcare Holdings launches tender offer for Charm Care shares at 1,970 yen
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days) | Purchase price: 1,970 yen per common share; 1 yen per stock acquisition right | Minimum tender number: 12,194,500 shares (37.25%); no maximum set | Filer indirectly holds 9,600,000 target shares (29.33%) via S.T.K.; S.T.K. will not tender | Ratio of shares tendered to total voting rights (a/j): 70.54%; post-tender ownership ratio: 99.87% (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: HOB Co.,Ltd.: HOB Co.,Ltd. board endorses tender offer by Takahashi Kikaku Co.,Ltd. at 1,140 yen per share.
item.description: Tender offer period: 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days) | Offer price: 1,140 yen per share | Minimum shares to be purchased: 202,500 shares; no maximum set | Board resolved on 2026-11-06 to express support for the offer and recommend tendering | Takahashi Iwao (305,000 shares, 40.07%) does not intend to tender; Takahashi Yukari (22,000 shares, 2.89%) intends to tender all her shares (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Shobunsha Holdings, Inc.: Shobunsha Holdings supports MSE's tender offer and recommends shareholders tender.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-06 to express support for the tender offer and recommend shareholders tender | Tender offeror is Kabushiki Kaisha MSE; tender period 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days) | Tender price is 752 yen per common share | Minimum tender number is 6,633,100 shares; no maximum is set | Offeror's ownership ratio after minimum purchase would be 66.36%; Shobunsha's controlling shareholder Kuroda Shigeo has agreed not to tender his 1,879,700 shares (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: CHARM CARE CORPORATION: Charm Care board backs Ship Healthcare Holdings tender offer at 1,970 yen per share
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-06 to support the tender offer and recommend that shareholders tender their shares. | Tender offer price is 1,970 yen per common share; each subscription right is priced at 1 yen. | Tender offer period runs from 2026-11-09 to 2026-12-21 (30 business days). | Minimum tender number is 12,194,500 shares; there is no maximum. | Subscription right holders are left to decide whether to tender; Ship Healthcare Holdings indirectly holds 9,600,000 shares (29.33%) through STK, which will not tender. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: PERSOL HOLDINGS CO., LTD.: PERSOL HOLDINGS to sell Programmed and PBS subsidiaries to Service Stream Holdings.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-09 to transfer all issued shares of Persol Australia Holdings Pty Ltd (Programmed) to Service Stream Holdings Pty Ltd; share transfer agreement signed the same day | Also resolved to transfer all issued shares of PERSOL APAC Business Support Services Sdn. Bhd. (PBS) to Service Stream Holdings Pty Ltd | Scheduled date of change in specified subsidiary: 2027-03-01 | Subsidiary capital: 920,001,000 Australian dollars; ownership before the change: 100% (indirect) | Expected gain on sale of subsidiary shares: 500億円, to be recorded in the Q4 of the fiscal year ending March 2027; final amount may change due to price adjustments and exchange rates (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Onamba Co., Ltd.: Onamba signs share acquisition agreement with Be Brave and related parties on 2026-11-06.
item.description: Agreement dated 2026-11-06 with Be Brave Kabushiki Kaisha, ESG Toshi Jigyo Kumiai, and Kazuto Izumida. | As of 2026-09-30, Be Brave and Kazuto Izumida held no shares of the company according to its shareholder register. | Be Brave must not transfer or otherwise dispose of unsold shares without the company's prior consent, except certain market sales. | Be Brave and related persons are restricted from acquiring company shares above the agreed holding ratio. | The board resolved the self-share acquisition on 2026-11-06, with acquired shares to be cancelled early after acquisition. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

Not investment advice.)

item.title: F.C.C.CO.,LTD.: F.C.C. reports US$42,800,000 dividend from North American subsidiary, effective 2026-11-06.
item.description: Event date: 2026-11-06 | Event: dividend paid by consolidated subsidiary FCC (North America),INC. | Dividend income of US$42,800,000 (approximately 6.7 billion yen) to be recorded as non-operating income in FY ending March 2027 standalone results | No material impact on FY ending March 2027 consolidated results, as the dividend is from a consolidated subsidiary | Conversion rate used: US$1 = 158.22 yen (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Mitsui Chemicals, Inc.: Mitsui Chemicals to acquire JSR Kabushiki Kaisha with DBJ, making it a consolidated subsidiary.
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-09 to acquire JSR Kabushiki Kaisha shares jointly with DBJ | Total acquisition consideration 18,400億円, including DBJ's share | Equity value 13,921億円, of which DBJ's contribution is 2,000億円 | Voting rights held after the transaction: 102,242,573; 100% of total voting rights | Completion targeted for the second half of FY2027, subject to approvals and conditions; timing may change (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: TOYOBO CO., LTD.: Toyobo reports 6.5 billion yen impairment loss on pharmaceutical contract manufacturing assets.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-09, the date of the board of directors resolution | Impairment loss of 6.5 billion yen recorded as an extraordinary loss in the pharmaceutical contract manufacturing business | Cause: competing products reduced contracted volumes, leading to a revised business plan | Recoverable amount of the business assets fell below carrying value, so carrying value was reduced to recoverable amount | Recorded in the consolidated and non-consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ending March 2027 interim period (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Nippon Paper Industries Co., Ltd.: Nippon Paper reports earthquake damage at Yatsushiro mill, with 150 oku yen (15 billion yen) extraordinary loss.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-07-28, when the Reiwa 8 Kumamoto Earthquake struck. | The Yatsushiro Mill (Yatsushiro City, Kumamoto Prefecture) suspended operations after suffering severe damage. | Earthquake-related losses were recorded as extraordinary losses in the non-consolidated financial results for the interim period of the fiscal year ending March 2027. | Non-consolidated extraordinary loss from the earthquake (Loss from disaster): 150 oku yen (15 billion yen). | Losses include fixed asset impairment, inventory valuation loss, and fixed costs during the suspension period. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Japan Pulp & Paper Co., Ltd.: Japan Pulp & Paper disposes 298,400 treasury shares to a trust for stock-based compensation.
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-09 to grant shares to directors and executive officers through a trust | Disposal of 298,400 shares at a disposal price of 1,203 yen per share, totaling 358,975,200 yen | Trust holds 1,858,474 shares in addition to the disposed shares; total planned delivery is 2,156,874 shares | Recipients: 3 directors (excluding outside directors) and 15 executive officers | Trustee is Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited, with the Company as settlor (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: KYOEI TANKER CO., LTD.: Kyoei Tanker books insurance gain and vessel departure-related loss for Q2.
item.description: Event occurred on 2026-11-06 involving the vessel CHALLENGE PROCYON owned by subsidiary KTS. | Special gain (insurance) of approx. 29億円 (approx. 2.9 billion yen) recorded. | Special loss of approx. 27億円 recorded, including a provision of approx. 22億円 (approx. 2.2 billion yen). | Net effect of the special gain and loss is a profit of approx. 2億円; offset against the provision alone, a profit of approx. 7億円. | Final amounts will vary with exchange rates and other factors as of end-December 2026. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: NIHON KAGAKU SANGYO CO.,LTD.: Board approves performance-linked share grant to directors via trust, offering 69,500 shares.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-09 to grant shares via trust to directors excluding outside directors, as performance-linked stock compensation. | Offering of 69,500 shares, with an additional 96,268 shares held in the trust. | Offering price 1,985 yen, the closing price on 2026-11-06 on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market. | Total offering value 137,957,500 yen; 267,740,379 yen including shares held in the trust. | Planned delivery of 165,768 shares through the trust to 5 directors; trustee is Mitsui Sumitomo Shintaku Ginko Kabushiki Kaisha. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: MIRAIT ONE Corporation: MIRAIT ONE resolves to inform group officers of stock benefit trust rules; 102,000-share disposal planned.
item.description: Board resolved on 2026-11-09 to inform group officers of the officer share grant rules under the BBT plan. | Planned disposal of 102,000 treasury shares at JPY 3,046 per share, with payment date 2026-11-24. | Trust held 405,100 shares as of 2026-10-31, making a total of 507,100 shares. | Issue price of JPY 3,046 is the 2026-11-06 Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price. | Total issue amount is JPY 310,692,000; 134 group officers are the solicitation recipients. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: ALPS ALPINE CO., LTD.: ALPS ALPINE records 8,889 million yen special loss over torque sensor quality issue.
item.description: Event date: 2026-10-30, the date of the board of directors resolution | Event concerns a quality issue in a specific production lot of automotive electric power steering torque sensors delivered to a customer | Product compensation loss of 8,889 million yen recorded as a special loss | The loss is recorded in the individual and consolidated results for the second quarter (interim period) of the fiscal year ending March 2027 | Filed under Article 19, Paragraph 2, Item 12 as an event significantly affecting financial position, business results and cash flows (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation: KUWAZAWA Holdings to dispose of 277,200 treasury shares to employee shareholding association
item.description: Board resolution dated 2026-11-09 approved the disposal of treasury shares. | Planned issue of 277,200 shares, assuming 252 shares each for up to 1,100 eligible employees; final number depends on participants. | Issue price JPY 704 per share, based on the closing price on the business day before the resolution; estimated total JPY 195,148,800. | Allottee is Kuwazawa Jugyoin Mochikabukai (1 party, 277,200 shares), with payment date 2027-03-12. | Transfer restriction period runs from 2027-03-12 to 2030-01-31. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Northsand, Inc.: Northsand files notice of overseas sales of up to half of 10,956,600-share secondary offering.
item.description: Board resolved the secondary offering of common shares on 2026-11-09; underwriter purchase offering covers 10,956,600 shares. | Overseas sales target investors in Europe and Asia, excluding the US and Canada; overseas sales quantity is no more than half of the offering shares, to be set between 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-20. | Underwriter is Daiwa Shoken K.K., which will purchase the offering shares; delivery is scheduled between 2026-11-25 and 2026-11-30. | Provisional offering price is 0.90 to 1.00 times the Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price on the pricing date; final price not yet determined. | Shares outstanding were 69,000,000 as of 2026-10-30; sellers are Tomohiro Maeda, Goonies K.K., Kohei Sasaki, Hiroki Kato, Ryota Komatsu and Tomoaki Kono. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)

item.title: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd.: Showa Sangyo to sell part of listed investment securities; expects 5,800 million yen gain.
item.description: On 2026-11-09 the board resolved to sell part of the company's listed investment securities. | Planned sale period is 2026-11-10 to 2027-03-31. | Expected investment securities sale gain of 5,800 million yen to be booked as extraordinary income in the FY ending March 2027, on both individual and consolidated results. | The gain estimate is based on current share prices and may change with future price movements. | Stated aim is to improve capital efficiency and financial position through review of policy-held shares under the Corporate Governance Code. (Source: EDINET, PDL1.0. Not investment advice.)
